$comment: Catalog operations the SDK deliberately does not expose, each with a reason.
catalog-coverage.test.ts requires every Zero query and mutator to be either mapped in
mapper.ts or listed here. A new backend operation therefore fails the check until
someone decides what to do with it.
Reason grammar: superseded-by:<name> | legacy-unused | internal | deferred:<why>
